games.name: Subterra ⛏️ [BETA]
games.desc:
Welcome to Subterra ⛏️! 
It's a 2.5 dimensional mining game with a procedurally generated world where you dig deeper, upgrade your pickaxe and survive layers that get more hostile the further you descend.

❓ [ How to Play ]
- Mine ores and upgrade your pickaxe to go even deeper.
- Build your character with Ability Cards.
- Craft Weapons that help you defeat monsters.
- Obtain rare recipes of weapons and potions.
- Explore various layers.
- Defeat Monsters and Bosses!

💻 [ Controls ]
- E to open Inventory
- C to Interact
- F to Block/Parry
- Left Mouse to Mine

💾 [BETA] 
The game is still under development, expect various changes. 
If you find bugs or have suggestions let us know in the community server!

Thank you for playing!

games.name: ⚔️ Sword Fights on the Heights IV: Reforged
games.desc:
Welcome to Sword Fights on The Heights IV: Reforged, a faithful remake of Shedletsky's classic game.

Reforged aims to bring the Heights back to their former glory — battle on a fixed and expanded map!

⚔️ Fight using classic and new swords: the Earthsplitter, Sky Dagger, Hyacinth, Voidcaller, and Flashbolt!

🥤 Fight with new and revamped power-ups such as the Jet Boots, Bloxy Cola, Slateskin Potion, and Flame Orb.

🔍 Discover hidden badges old and new throughout the map!

🚩 Participate in community events and streaking tournaments.
_________________________________________________

Join the community server for tournaments, event news, and announcements.

Sword Fights on The Heights IV: Reforged is a remaster of Shedletsky's Sword Fights on The Heights IV.  As such, all credit goes to Shedletsky and the original game.
